# OpenVideo

> OpenVideo is an open-source Video-as-Code platform built for coding agents. A video is a JSON document (the Composition IR) or TSX that compiles to it; every frame is a pure function of composition, assets, frame and seed. Agents create, validate, render single frames, inspect, patch and render final videos through one API (HTTP, MCP, CLI).

Documentation is English first; German versions sit next to a file as `*.de.md` (for example `README.de.md`, `docs/ai/AGENTS.de.md`). Architecture decision records are German. Identifiers, JSON keys and error messages are English.

## Start here

- [Setup](SETUP.md): OpenVideo is not on npm; this file tells a coding assistant how to build it from source, link the `openvideo` command and register the MCP server (`npm run setup`)
- [Agent guide](docs/ai/AGENTS.md): workflow, output examples, rules, animation (`$keyframes`, `$spring`, `$expr`, `$sampled`, `$ref`), node types, patches, preview patches, diagnostics, TSX, manifests, plugins, live events
- [Recipes](docs/guide/recipes.md): small verified IR snippets for common tasks
- [Getting started](docs/guide/getting-started.md): install, create, dev (Studio with live sync), render
- [Examples](examples/README.md): five complete projects (JSON and TSX, 2D, 3D, 9:16) and an MCP client configuration
- [Capability manifest](docs/ai/capabilities.json): 31 node types, 29 components, 31 operations, 15 templates, 17 blend modes, backends, formats (generated)
- Live self-description: the 31 operations include `capabilities.get` and `schema.get`; the MCP server (`openvideo mcp --project <dir>`) also serves `openvideo://agents.md`, `openvideo://schema.json` and `openvideo://capabilities.json`

## Reference

- [JSON Schema of the Composition IR](packages/schema/openvideo.schema.json)
- [Render semantics](docs/reference/node-semantics.md): coordinates, boxes, paint, text, media, 3D, compositing across backends, one JSON example per node type
- [Render manifest](docs/reference/render-manifest.md): fields of the render manifest and the short frame manifest
- [Agent API operations](docs/guide/api.md): all 31 operations with return fields and input examples, HTTP endpoints (including `GET /v1/events`), one example per patch kind (generated)
- [CLI](docs/guide/cli.md): commands, options, exit codes; `openvideo op <name> --input <json|@file>` runs any operation (generated)
- [Plugins](docs/guide/plugins.md): agent tools (`plugin.<name>` operations), codecs, exporters, asset loaders, Studio panels, permissions
- [Architecture](_bmad-output/planning-artifacts/architecture/architecture-agentic-video-engine-2026-09-28/ARCHITECTURE-SPINE.md) and [ADRs](docs/adr/README.md)
- [API reference](https://deltatree.github.io/agentic-video-engine/): TypeScript packages (TypeDoc, generated by `.github/workflows/docs.yml`; locally `npm run docs` writes `docs/api/`)
